content: Sequence labeling. NER is widely treated as a sequence labeling problem, by assigning a unique label over each sentential word BIBREF9 . Early studies on sequence labeling often use the models of HMM, MEMM, and CRF BIBREF10 based on manually-crafted discrete features, which can suffer the feature sparsity problem and require heavy feature engineering. Recently, neural network models have been successfully applied to sequence labeling BIBREF1 , BIBREF11 , BIBREF2 . Among these work, the model which uses Bi-LSTM for feature extraction and CRF for decoding has achieved state-of-the-art performances BIBREF11 , BIBREF2 , which is exploited as the baseline model in our work.
